capabilities: display a local graph banner in the note header
customize banner appearance via Style Settings
save local graph settings via Sync Graph Settings
extras: The README notes that graph settings synchronization is only applied the first time a note is opened, so the app must be reloaded after changing those settings.
problem: Obsidian's local graph is shown in a separate pane, so it is not visible directly at the top of the note you are reading.

relations.evidence: You can customize the banner appearance via Style Settings plugin.
You can save the local graph settings via Sync Graph Settings plugin.

summary: Plugin that renders the local graph of the current note as a banner in the note header.
